Hierarchy, labels, section order, text sizes, and contrast pass outside F3. Optional missing photographs create no empty image boxes, as D7 permits. No additional photograph is required.
The approved pictures show no staff header, preview banner, or cut face. Primary and Tutor preserve their source ratios. Reading omits its staff controls.
